mapper.select: SELECT poc.sku_id, s.erp_code, s.en_name, s.image_source, po.country, c.code, COALESCE(NULLIF(po.logistic_channel_name, ''), po.invoice_logistic_channel_name) as channelName, SUM(COALESCE(poc.quantity, 0)) as quantity FROM client_sku cs JOIN platform_order_content poc ON poc.sku_id = cs.sku_id JOIN platform_order po ON po.id = poc.platform_order_id JOIN sku s ON s.id = poc.sku_id JOIN country c ON c.name_en = po.country OR c.special_name = po.country WHERE cs.client_id =#{clientId} AND po.order_time >= #{startDate} AND po.erp_status in ('3', '4') AND po.country IS NOT NULL AND po.country != '' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(po.logistic_channel_name, ''), po.invoice_logistic_channel_name) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cs.client_id, poc.sku_id, s.erp_code, s.en_name, po.country, channelName ORDER BY po.country, quantity desc

SELECT lcp.*, target_lc.zh_name AS price_channel_name FROM logistic_channel target_lc JOIN logistic_channel price_lc ON price_lc.id = target_lc.id OR price_lc.id = target_lc.same_price_channel_id JOIN logistic_channel_price lcp ON lcp.channel_id = price_lc.id JOIN country c ON c.code = lcp.effective_country WHERE target_lc.zh_name = #{channelName} AND (c.name_en = #{country} OR c.special_name = #{country}) AND lcp.weight_range_start <= #{weight} AND lcp.weight_range_end >= #{weight} ORDER BY lcp.effective_date DESC, lcp.id ASC
